item.title: Dopamine v3.0.10
item.description:
Dopamine 3.0.10 | Dopamine
- Expose an API to frida that allows it to hook memory over hookd, fixes panics when using frida on iOS 26+ (Fix is in frida-gum upstream but a stable build on fridas end is still pending) (contributed by @devnoname120) - Fix Xcode debugging being broken on iOS 17+ after a userspace reboot if a developer disk image was already mounted before the userspace reboot
